svg.title: FLP impossibility
svg.desc: Two copies of a 3 node cluster. In both, the term 7 leader stops sending heartbeats, and the followers cannot tell whether it is dead or just slow. Without a timeout the silence clock keeps running and nothing is decided. With a 1,000 ms election timeout, follower 2 asks for votes, follower 3 says yes, and follower 2 leads term 8 while follower 3 keeps getting heartbeats.

g.text: dead or slow? no way to know
a guess, but the cluster moves on

svg.text: Dead and slow look the same. Without a timeout, the cluster waits forever.
